description: Bid Transaction Race Condition and Inconsistency During high-volume bidding periods, multiple bid processors may simultaneously attempt to process bids for the same ad slot. Without proper transaction isolation and rollback mechanisms, this can lead to race conditions where the final state of the bid is incorrect or inconsistent. An attacker could exploit this by flooding the system with rapid bid requests, causing race conditions that result in duplicate bid acceptances or lost bids, potentially leading to financial losses.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1499 - Endpoint Denial of Service
recommendation: Implement proper transaction isolation in the bidding service
recommendation: Add bid state machine and rollback mechanisms

description: Insufficient Transport Layer Security Without proper TLS configuration and certificate management, communications between various components could be vulnerable to interception and modification. An attacker could perform a man-in-the-middle attack to intercept bid requests, modify bid amounts, or steal sensitive advertiser information.
references: recommendation: Implement certificate rotation and monitoring

description: Insufficient Authentication and Authorization The current implementation relies on API keys and IAM roles but lacks proper user authentication and session management. WAF protection is inconsistent across different user types. An attacker could steal API keys or exploit the lack of proper session management to impersonate advertisers or bypass spending limits.
references: recommendation: Implement Cognito user pools for advertiser authentication
recommendation: Extend WAF protection to all endpoints

description: Cache Inconsistency and Data Race Conditions Cache inconsistencies can occur due to race conditions during concurrent updates or failed write-through operations to the primary data store. An attacker could exploit timing windows between cache and database updates to manipulate bid data or cause financial inconsistencies.
references: recommendation: Implement robust cache consistency patterns
recommendation: Add monitoring and alerting for cache inconsistencies

description: Insufficient Data Privacy in Analytics Pipeline Sensitive user and bid data flows through multiple analytics components without proper anonymization or access controls, potentially exposing PII or business-sensitive information. An attacker with access to the analytics pipeline or data lake could extract sensitive user information or competitive bidding data.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

description: Denial of Service Through Bid Request Flooding The system could be overwhelmed by a high volume of bid requests, either malicious or due to misconfigured clients, leading to service degradation. An attacker could flood the system with bid requests to overwhelm resources or cause processing delays that affect legitimate bids.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1498 - Network Denial of Service
recommendation: Add request validation and filtering

description: Insecure Direct Object References in Campaign Management Campaign management endpoints might not properly validate object ownership and access rights, allowing unauthorized access to or modification of campaign data. An attacker could modify campaign IDs or reference parameters to access or modify campaigns belonging to other advertisers.
references: recommendation: Implement robust access control checks
recommendation: Add audit logging for campaign operations
